cc:Work.dc:title: Box - UniversalBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with various options for different styles and lids
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes UniversalBox --x 100 --y 100 --h 80 --outside 1 --bottom_edge h --top_edge F --vertical_edges 'finger joints' --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes UniversalBox --h --top_edge --reference
